Reviewed revision: Git 88aa4906102f2e304d1039d2e70942503ec9b341 (“Implement receipt-linked atomic execution and clearing proofs”). Requested role: native independent Grok source review, not a proof oracle and not an execution/evidence audit. I inspected the frozen tree and the supplied OpenSpec. I did not run lake, Lean, Python, OpenSpec, or hash recomputation. I did not use Foreman. No source was edited.

The commit adds `lean/DefiKernel/Atomic/*`, a one-line root import in `lean/DefiKernel.lean`, `scripts/check_atomic_mutations.py`, `scripts/test_atomic_mutation_runner.py`, and `review/semantic-kernel/sprint8/mutation-spec.json`. Earlier Interleaving/Parallel/Composition/Typed modules are not rewritten in this commit.

BLOCKERS

None substantiated from source against the accepted Sprint 8 SHALL text.

I did not find a production definition that drops actual-prefix connection, signed receipt-origin debt, participant coverage, policy-abort conservation, pointwise clearance, local principal/time, lane-supply restriction, public rollback, noncircular converse, initialized invariant premises, or the named public comparator. Comments were not treated as evidence.

REQUIRED CHANGES

None for this source review. Full post-freeze acceptance and the 18 production-mutant runs remain pending by the stated development claim; they are not source defects in this freeze.

NONBLOCKING LIMITATIONS

1. This is source review only. I did not elaborate `Audit.lean`/`Verify.lean`, so I cannot confirm the stated 129 runtime comparisons, 357 theorems, 487 supplemental checks, or forbidden=0. `Tests.runtimeChecks` concatenates seven lists; named tuples plus generated receipt-field names count to 130 in source. That is a listing count, not an executed result.

2. Field-sensitivity oracles in `lean/DefiKernel/Atomic/Tests.lean` (approximately lines 266–370) mostly compare constructed `Observation` values through production `observationEq`. Live `observe (runAtomic …)` is used by `checkExpected` fixtures and by `atomic.observe.diagnostic.erased`. A comparator-only matrix would miss an `observe`-side field drop; the live abort/residual fixtures (`atomic.fixture.abort.middle.public`, `atomic.fixture.settlement.under`, `atomic.fixture.settlement.cross.principal`, and siblings) still go through production projection.

3. Committed correspondence is machine/attempt/clearance correspondence, not a named equality with Interleaving’s branch-observation type. `runAtomic_commit_interleaving` (`Completion.lean`) equates `Interleaving.runInterleaving` with `.executed schedule m.speculative`. `runAtomic_commit_of_interleaving` / `runAtomic_commit_iff_interleaving` (`Correspondence.lean`) use `GoodAttempts` and `outstandingFromAttempts` on the Interleaving attempt list. That matches the adopted noncircular route. There is no theorem that Atomic `observe` equals Interleaving `observationsEqual` field-for-field.

4. Atomic-native `localBoundary`, `timedDraw`, and `liveDraw` in `Examples.lean` are unused by `Tests.lean`. Local principal/time, live reads, and peer-history are exercised by wrapping existing Interleaving fixtures through `oldRun` (empty-lane batch policy). Those paths are real `runAtomic` paths; they are not extra settlement evidence.

5. Mutation designs were not compiled. Needles occur once in the targeted production modules; replacements use existing APIs (`Interleaving.advance`, `Machine.setLocal`, `Capability.live`, `checkSupply`, `residuals`, `observationEq`). Four mutants share the single `Interleaving.advance` line in `Execution.lean:103` (stale-world, peer-history, global-boundary, resurrect). Three share the `owed - receiptEffect` line in `Policy.lean:82`. The runner applies each mutant to a fresh copy, so shared needles are not a uniqueness failure. Overlap of live-read oracles is the disclosed historical overlap, not a missing mutant.

6. `scripts/test_atomic_mutation_runner.py` `cases()` lists 63 CLI controls, a superset of the frozen “52 Interleaving cases,” with Atomic roots/names (`discovered-atomic-dependency`, `DefiKernel.Atomic.Audit`). Extra proof-tail cases do not drop the established set. Those controls were not executed here.

7. `decide +kernel` appears in instance/fixture files (`InvariantFixtures.lean`). I found no `sorry`, custom axiom, or `native_decide` under `lean/DefiKernel/Atomic/`. Generic theorems are tactic proofs over executable definitions placed before `-- BEGIN PROOFS`.

CLAIM/SCOPE CHECK

Actual-prefix connection. `Atomic.advance` (`Execution.lean:97–120`) is inert after abort; otherwise it calls existing `Interleaving.advance` once and inspects `next.attempts[m.speculative.attempts.length]?`. `Reachable` (`Soundness.lean`) is start/next over that `advance`. `runPrefix_prefix` witnesses a literal schedule prefix, not a reordered trace. `interleaving_advance_appended` proves an active selected invocation appends exactly one attempt equal to `executeStep` at local `nextIndex`.

Signed typed receipt effect. `receiptEffect` (`Policy.lean:72–75`) is `e.effect cell` on an invoked receipt and 0 otherwise. `Evaluated.effect` sums every evaluated delta at that cell, including repeats. `updateOutstanding` subtracts that amount only for `(lane ∈ policy.lanes ∧ p = principal)` using `(boundaries attempt.branch attempt.index).ctx.principal` (`Execution.lean:113–114`). `step_receipt_balance` (`Settlement.lean:29–39`) ties the applied post-balance to that same `receiptEffect` via `applyEvaluated_ok_iff`. No caller-supplied debt or operation-name branch is used.

Participant completeness. `checkPolicy` (`Policy.lean:56–70`) is lane-pair uniqueness, participant uniqueness, then left coverage, then right coverage. `uncoveredFrom` walks every static invocation, including unreachable suffixes. `checkPolicy_ok_iff` / `checkPolicy_covers` (`PolicyProofs.lean`) are the admitted characterization. Fixtures: alternate-vault duplicate (`Tests.lean` `atomic.admission.lane.alternate.vault`), duplicate participant, uncovered peer, uncovered suffix index 1, extra unused participant allowed.

Debt conservation including policy abort. `Reachable.cash_owed` (`Settlement.lean:118–160`) inducts through `advance`, including `.ok` then `checkSupply` failure: outstanding is still `attemptOutstanding` of the successful receipt (`advance_outstanding`, `Execution.lean:112–120` keeps `owed` on the diagnostic machine, then sets `laneSupply`). The law is vault cash plus the full participant sum equals entry cash, not a supplied unrelated receipt list. `Reachable.outstanding_fold` equates the maintained table with `outstandingFromAttempts`.

All-key clearance. `residuals` enumerates lane-major, participant-minor, nonzero only (`Policy.lean:85–87`). `residuals_eq_nil_iff` is pointwise zero on the configured rectangle. `Reachable.cleared_cash` restores each configured vault on that condition. Live counterexamples: under +1, over −1, peer +7/−7, asset/domain split, last-lane share residual, last-participant Bob residual, noop preserving 7. `scalar_netting_counterexample` (`InvariantFixtures.lean:100–103`) is a checked sum-zero / nonempty residual pair.

Local principal / history / time. Interleaving `advance` uses `boundaries b own.nextIndex` and `own.outputs` (`Interleaving/Execution.lean:113–114`). Atomic does not rebind that call except in mutants. `atomic.fixture.boundary.local` uses schedule `[.right, .left, .left, .right]` against timed boundaries. Peer-only vs own-history and live vault reads are `oldRun` fixtures. Abort reasons store local `attempt.index` and zero-based `m.position`.

Supply restrictions. `checkSupply` is the first policy lane with `receipt.supply domain asset ≠ 0` (`Policy.lean:89–91`; `Receipt.supply` uses `Evaluated.supply`). Nonvault USD mint aborts `laneSupply` with amount 3 while vault cash is unchanged (`afterLaneMint`). Authorized share mint with nonempty USD settlement commits (`atomic.fixture.supply.nonlane`, `shareSupply`). Policy abort after a prior draw keeps diagnostic debt 7 (`laneMintAfterDraw`).

Full rollback. `Result.publicWorld` on abort/refuse is the entry world (`Execution.lean:78–81`). `committedHistory` / `committedSupply` are empty/zero on refuse and abort and are the only history/supply fields in `observe` (`Observation.lean:25–31`). `runAtomic_noncommit_identity` covers every noncommit constructor, full world/store, empty history, zero supply. Follow-up from `abortedProducer.publicWorld` cannot consume the speculative mint (`atomic.fixture.followup.fresh.history`).

Noncircular converse. `runAtomic_commit_of_interleaving` premises are admission, `GoodAttempts` on `Interleaving.runPrefix` attempts (kernel success and `checkSupply = none`), and `residuals policy (outstandingFromAttempts … interleavingAttempts) = []`. It does not assume an Atomic result. `underlying_success_does_not_imply_commit` is the unpaid draw-7 counterexample.

Invariant premises. `runAtomic_two_invariants` (`Preservation.lean:171–189`) takes initialized ledger predicates, `LocalObligation`, `CrossInclusion`, and `Stable`. Commit uses actual-prefix Interleaving R/G; abort uses rollback identity. There is no internal zero-table hypothesis. `nonempty_transient_invariant` has lanes nonempty, Alice owed 7, vault 3, collateral 9. `empty_support_is_false` is the missing-support counterexample. Authority theorems use `attempt.before` and trusted `boundaries attempt.branch attempt.index`; initial stores remain trust premises.

Full public-field comparison. `observationEq` compares label, schedule, `Outcome` (hence admission reason, kernel/policy/unsettled payload including residual lists), `worldEq` (every cell and the capability store), committed events, and pointwise supply. Aborted diagnostics are omitted by `observe`, not by dropping abort fields. Production `committedHistory` / `committedSupply` are the projection accessors.

Independent fixtures. `Examples.lean` builds expected worlds from `balanceTable`/`atomWorld` and expected receipts from `expectedTransfer`/`event`, not from `runAtomic` results. Transient positives have a nonempty lane and a checked nonzero intermediate (`draw.prefix` owed 7). Empty-lane `batch.single` is named batch, not settlement evidence. Collateral 9 is protected. Funded siblings exist for history and follow-up.

Mutation / runner design. Eighteen named mutants in `review/semantic-kernel/sprint8/mutation-spec.json` rewrite production `publicWorld`, abort continuation, committed history/supply, the Interleaving call, `updateOutstanding`, `residuals`, `checkSupply`, and `observationEq`. Designated false oracles are independent live comparisons (`abort.middle.public`, `abort.first.stopped`, `abort.outputs`, `abort.supply`, `live.complete`, `history.peer.only`, `boundary.local`, `settlement.noop`, `settlement.under`, `cross.principal`, `cross.asset`/`cross.domain`, `last.lane`, `last.participant`, `supply.lane.nonvault`, `capability.revoked`, `observe.abort.reason`, `observe.residual.amount`). Protected positives are empty identity, catalog/store, empty-lane batch, and `observe.equal`. The runner requires outside-repo output, Git blob identity, nonempty unique observations, no post-marker runtime declarations, and compiler-error ≠ financial detection. Execution of the 18 mutants and 63 CLI cases is not claimed here.

Scope. Theorems and fixtures stay inside finite exact rationals, binary schedules, trusted boundaries, and a restricted lane-supply/clearing policy. I did not see deployed Balancer, machine-arithmetic, fairness, provenance, associativity, order-independence, general signed spendable, or in-transaction capability-mutation claims. Empty-lane batch and Interleaving-wrapped history/time fixtures are ordinary atomic batch mode, not transient-settlement evidence. Those limitations do not waive the Sprint 8 admission, abort, settlement, preservation, or correspondence obligations as encoded in the Atomic sources above.
